attchmntText: TIL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE".
voiceSummary: TIL Limited reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of 198 Cr, a 143% year-on-year increase, with consolidated EBITDA rising 433% to 17.37 Cr. Standalone operating revenue reached 101 Cr, up 29% year-on-year. The company recorded its first cash profit in five quarters, narrowing the net loss to 1.71 Cr. Consolidated order book stands at 534 Cr, comprising 391 Cr in prime products and 143 Cr in aftermarket. TCPL, consolidated from 8th May 2026, contributed 92 Cr in standalone revenue. H1 FY27 consolidated revenue totaled 315 Cr. The company delivered 20 ReachStackers and secured a large-value defence maintenance contract. Foreign exchange movements and logistics costs impacted the bottom line. TIL expects sustained growth in H2 FY27 driven by order book conversion and TCPL contributions.

attchmntText: TIL Limited has informed the Exchange about Forfeiture
voiceSummary: TIL Limited has approved the forfeiture of 65,323 partly paid-up Rights Equity Shares. This action follows the non-payment of the first and final call money of Rs. 41.25 per share by the holders. The Board of Directors made this decision at its meeting on 14th November, 2026. The unpaid amount includes Rs. 2.50 towards face value and Rs. 38.75 towards premium. The company also forfeits the application money of Rs. 123.75 per share. Notices regarding this forfeiture will be issued to the affected shareholders. The Board has decided not to reissue these shares. The rights issue was originally allotted on 9th April, 2026. Payment was due after notices issued in June, July, and August 2026.

TIL Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report of CARE Ratings Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 32 of SEBI LODR. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Rights Issue aggregating Rs. 199.51 crore. The company received call money of Rs. 49.61 crore against 1,20,26,437 fully paid-up equity shares. Utilization included Rs. 38.28 crore for repayment of borrowings, Rs. 10.53 crore for General Corporate Purposes, and Rs. 0.33 crore for issue expenses. No deviation from the objects of the issue was reported. A shortfall of Rs. 0.27 crore due to non-receipt of call money on 65,323 shares was adjusted via forfeiture. Excess issue expenses of Rs. 0.33 crore were adjusted against General Corporate Purposes. The Board will consider the shortfall adjustment in a meeting scheduled for November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: TIL Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: TIL Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 14th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 10,066 Lakhs for the quarter and 17,927 Lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit before tax was loss of 193 Lakhs for the quarter and loss of 1,155 Lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative 0.22 for the quarter and negative 1.13 for the half year. The company created deferred tax assets of 10,944 Lakhs. The statutory auditors V. Singhi & Associates issued a review report with an emphasis of matter regarding the realization of deferred tax assets. Previous year audits were conducted by M/s. Singhi & Co. The board also considered statements on deviations in share issues and related party transactions.
